## Which one do I want?

- **Android phone:** download the `.apk` below and open it on your phone. After that, the app checks for updates itself (Settings → App updates), or you can follow releases with [Obtainium](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium).
- **Any phone (Android or iPhone) or browser:** install the PWA next to your party-console with Docker. It's one service in your `compose.yaml`, using the image `ghcr.io/icelocked/party-console-pwa`. See the [PWA install guide](https://github.com/Icelocked/adventure-land-mobile-party-console/blob/main/DEPLOYMENT.md#4-pwa-self-hosted-next-to-party-console). Once it's installed, it can update itself from Settings.
- **The `.zip`** holds the PWA's web files for people hosting it some other way. Most people want the Docker install instead.

New to this? Start with the [README](https://github.com/Icelocked/adventure-land-mobile-party-console#install), which covers getting your phone to your PC with Tailscale.
